_note: Everything past the basics is opened through adventures. Each unlock has 'earn': every condition must be met ('find': a special item a pet brought home from a trip, see 'finds' and the events that give them; 'first': the first of something, e.g. 'part'; 'packs_opened': packs you opened yourself). 'show' is how it looks until then: 'locked' (a tab with a padlock and the 'hint') or 'hidden' (not there at all; automation is always hidden). 'opens' is what it turns on: 'tab:<name>', 'feature:<id>' (errands, packs = your pet opening your pile of boxes, shopping = it buys more when the pile runs out, parties) or 'page:<id>' (a map page). 'announce' is what your active pet says when it opens.

unlocks.hint: pets bring things home from their trips
unlocks.announce: a pet brought something home! it's in your inventory now!
a little basket! now i can send friends to fetch things while you're busy!
a cart! more friends can go on trips together now! and look, there's a gate in the fence!!
a comfy cushion! i can sit here and open packs for you!
a piggy bank! now i can buy boxes when the pile runs out! i'll always keep some coins for you ♪
